minutes.headline: Committee approved FY2018 carryover orders and heard Bengals' turf-fee plea; fee left for August
minutes.summary: The committee approved year-end carryover purchase orders and a year-one middle school field hockey plan, and appointed the superintendent to a collaborative board. It heard the Bengals youth football group ask for a lower turf field fee, and a mentor described the new-superintendent program. Middle school basketball was deferred to the new athletic director, and the primary principal search was reset with an interim hire.

what_happened.line: The committee left the Bengals youth football turf-field fee unresolved; the superintendent is to work on a fee structure for the August meeting.
The committee took a vote on carrying over fiscal 2018 purchase orders; the outcome is not audible in the recording.
A year-one middle school field hockey plan went to a vote, funded by player fees with a school share phased in over five years; the outcome is not audible.
The committee voted on naming the superintendent as spokesperson and executive board member of the collaborative; the outcome is not audible.
Votes on a third reading of pregnancy-related policy changes and on the meeting calendar followed; outcomes are not audible.

why_it_matters: Turf-field fees for outside groups like youth football affect who can afford to use town fields, and any fee the schools set may be revisited in August.
The field hockey plan shifts cost from player fees to the school budget over five years, which is a future cost to taxpayers.
